description: Worn smooth, grey-blue and cold in the palm. Every pond blob keeps one, and none of them will say why.
lore: Four. The cheapest thing sold in Nangijala, and nearly the only one where the buyer volunteers what it is for: a hand at a fire wants a job while the mouth does the hard part, and a smooth stone is a job. The tellers keep a bowl of them by the log. At most fires you are not asked your name until you have picked one up.

As for the [[monsters/water_poring|Puddlings]] — a woman who spent a season at the shallows watching them says she has the answer and it is not interesting, only sad. A thing made of water needs one part of itself that stays put. Otherwise it has no way of knowing which direction is down.
